Burgundy Velvet & Gold Drops
Rights check
Source: 24373.jpg
IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long, dark brown wavy
hair parted at the center wears gold drop earrings and a
deep burgundy velvet top with a V-neck. Her
expression is calm and composed, with a neutral pink
lip and subtle, defined brows. A soft gray studio
backdrop with gentle light. Palette of burgundy, gold,
and warm neutral skin tones. Refined and sleek, in the
style of a runway beauty editorial.
Refined, sleek, understated
WORKING NOTES
- The burgundy velvet and gold drops are the color
accents.
- Use 'close-up, head and shoulders' for a beauty-focused
crop.
